dataset: KU Leuven Drone RF Dataset V1.0

signal_type.basis: The DE-FEND paper's Table II lists SJRC pro with signal type RC among unknown sources.

open_set_role.basis: The DE-FEND paper trains on Table I sources and evaluates novelty detection with Table II sources, which include SJRC pro RC.

capture_environment.value: clean raw IQ in an RMA semi-anechoic chamber, without other communication interference
capture_environment.basis: DE-FEND database-development section and the official dataset README.

mat_member_to_physical_session_mapping.basis: The official README, public repository metadata and reviewed papers do not map sjrc__0 through sjrc__50 to independent acquisition sessions.

protocol_decision.decision: Lock the entire SJRC_pro archive as one external_unknown_test group.
protocol_decision.reason: This matches the paper's unknown-source role and prevents member-level train/test leakage despite unresolved physical-session relationships.

remaining_blocker: A compatible single-band IQ model and known-only calibration protocol must be frozen before any external-unknown evaluation.
